title: Zephyr: monotonic uptime tracking
description: Monotonic uptime tracking. AC: Returns monotonic time since boot, never decreases.
notes: Implemented Zephyr/C monotonic uptime tracker and k_uptime_get sampler while preserving the shared build/provision epoch changes. Equal observations are accepted; regressions and u64 wrap-to-zero return -ERANGE without mutating the last accepted tick; negative platform samples return -EIO without mutating output/state; unobserved now returns -EAGAIN. Added canonical packets-timing monotonic sequence coverage plus sampling regression/error tests. Standalone AppleClang/UBSan ctest passed 1/1; git diff --check and clang-format dry-run passed.
close_reason: Implemented and validated nondecreasing boot-relative uptime tracking with deterministic regression, wrap, and platform-error handling.
